query: We're a Kolkata two-wheeler rental company and expect about 6,000,000 route (directions) requests a month, all in India. Which routing APIs could we use, and what would each cost per month in rupees?
context:
- Ola Maps – Full API pricing details (effective 1 Sept 2026) (https://maps.olakrutrim.com/pricing/details): Your first 100,000 calls per API are included each month.
- Ola Maps OpenAPI spec (ola-maps-apis-oas.yaml) (https://maps.olakrutrim.com/openapi/ola-maps-apis-oas.yaml): Directions Basic: "This excludes real-time traffic data."; waypoints "Up to 10 waypoints.
- Google Maps Platform core services pricing list – India (effective Aug 1, 2024; page updated 2026-11-03) (https://developers.google.com/maps/billing-and-pricing/pricing-india): Routes API Legacy pricing: Directions (India) free cap 70,000; $1.50 (cap–5M) / $0.38 (5M+) per 1,000; Directions Advanced (India) 35,000; $3.00 / $0.75
- Directions API (Legacy) – Getting directions (https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/directions/get-directions): As of October 2026, Directions API (Legacy) can no longer be enabled for new Google Cloud projects. Existing projects remain fully supported.
- Mapbox pricing (https://www.mapbox.com/pricing): Directions API: up to 100,000 requests free; $2.00 (100,001–500,000), $1.60 (500,001–1,000,000), $1.20 (1,000,001+) per 1,000; 5,000,000+ contact sales
- OSRM wiki – Demo server (https://github.com/Project-OSRM/osrm-backend/wiki/Demo-server): the demo server usage is restricted to reasonable, non-commercial use-cases. Do not exceed 1 request per second. We provide no guarantees wrt. uptime, latency, or data updates.
- RBI homepage – Exchange Rates (Source: FBIL) (https://www.rbi.org.in/): INR / 1 USD : 93.8075 ... (As at 1.00pm of November 11, 2026) (Source : FBIL)
reference_answer:
Estimated monthly list prices for 6,000,000 Directions requests in India:
- Ola Maps Directions: ≈ ₹1,024,100.00. The first 100,000 calls are free, then ₹0.199 per request up to 5M and ₹0.049 above 5M. Directions Basic has no real-time traffic and comes to ≈ ₹510,100.00.
- Google Maps Platform (India price list): Directions (Legacy) and Routes API Compute Routes Essentials have the same India rate (70,000 free, then USD 1.50(≈ ₹140.71) per 1,000 up to 5M and USD 0.38(≈ ₹35.65) per 1,000 from 5M to 10M), so 6,000,000 requests ≈ USD 7,775.00(≈ ₹729,353.31). Traffic-aware routes are billed as Directions Advanced / Compute Routes Pro (35,000 free, then USD 3.00 / 0.75(≈ ₹281.42 / ₹70.36)), ≈ USD 15,645.00(≈ ₹1,467,618.34). New Google Cloud projects can't enable Directions (Legacy) as of Oct 2026, so they must use the Routes API.
- Mapbox Directions: the list tiers end at 5,000,000 requests. Beyond that Mapbox shows 'contact sales', so no list total applies.
- OSRM (OpenStreetMap data): open source with no list price. The public demo server is for reasonable non-commercial use only, at most 1 request per second, with no guarantees. Production use means self-hosting it. Nominatim is a geocoder and has no routing API.
USD amounts are converted at ₹93.8075/USD, the FBIL reference rate shown on rbi.org.in (as at 1:00 pm IST, 11 Nov 2026). Prices are list prices.

query: Mapbox reverse geocoding returns a region and country but not the street address we expected. How can we ask for address features?
context: - Geocoding API (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/search/geocoding/): documents reverse-geocoding result hierarchy and `types` filtering.
reference_answer: Use the reverse endpoint with the `types=address` filter to ask for address features. Mapbox documents that reverse geocoding can return features at multiple administrative levels, and its default is at most one feature at each level (for example, address, region and country). The docs do not guarantee that an address feature exists for every coordinate, so verify the returned feature types rather than assuming a missing address is an API fault.
cited_doc_spans:
[1] https://docs.mapbox.com/api/search/geocoding/ | "The reverse geocoding query type allows you to look up a pair of coordinates and returns the geographic features there, including a standardized address or place and full geographic context." | supports: Reverse lookup result description (verbatim)
[2] https://docs.mapbox.com/api/search/geocoding/ | "The default behavior in reverse geocoding is to return at most one feature at each of the multiple levels of the administrative hierarchy (for example, one address, one region, one country)." | supports: Default hierarchy result behaviour (verbatim)
[3] https://docs.mapbox.com/api/search/geocoding/ | "$curl "https://api.mapbox.com/search/geocode/v6/reverse?longitude=-73.989&latitude=40.733&types=address&access_token=YOUR_MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN"" | supports: Address feature filter example (verbatim)
